Resolves #22004

`dev` fails `CaptureExamples.spec.mjs`, so every open pull request's unit check fails on its merge ref. #21985 shoots each covered record without a recipe twice, its dark landing frame and its `-light` partner, under one id. #21996 then made `timeline-basic` Grid & Table's first such record, and its version of this spec counts one row per id. Test-only: the spec now compares the set of ids with the covered records, keeps a recipe record to one row with its steps, and asks each landing record for exactly its dark and `-light` rows.

Evidence: L2 (the unit spec, red on `dev`, green here, red again under a mutation) → L2 required (a unit spec's expectation).

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/CaptureExamples.spec.mjs`, "the committed Grid/Table catalog selects a capture for every covered card". On `dev` 0773ec79c6 it fails with `timeline-basic` twice (22 rows for 21 records); at this head it passes. With the light scheme dropped from `PAIR_THEMES` in a scratch worktree it fails again (`['']` where `['', '-light']` is due), and an id missing from the rows fails the set equality. |
| AC-2 | Post-merge: an open pull request's unit check is green on its merge ref again (see below). |
